description: This file defines a PermissionManager for handling various macOS permissions including location, notifications, microphone, camera, screen recording, and speech recognition. It includes utility helpers for opening system preferences related to permissions, a singleton class for monitoring permission status, and specific implementations for requesting and checking permissions in an asynchronous context.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: A singleton class managing location permission requests, including handling user prompts, timeouts, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: A singleton observable class that periodically monitors and updates the status of various permissions, notifying observers when changes occur.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the current location authorization status is sufficient, considering whether 'always' authorization is required.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures a list of capabilities are granted, returning a dictionary of capability to boolean results.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Checks and requests a specific capability's permission, depending on the capability type.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current status of all defined capabilities, returning a dictionary.
